description: Ministère des Sports (published on the Région Réunion open data portal) publishes the list of sports installations of La Réunion with names, addresses and locations, taken from the national census of sports facilities; fields include the survey file status and dates, accessibility for people with disabilities, on-site keeper, accommodation and catering possibilities and the number of facilities attached to each installation. Coverage: the island of La Réunion; about 2,850 installations, record last modified on 2022-06-28. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the open data portal of the Région Réunion. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence Ouverte (Etalab); cost: free. Caveats: a 2022 snapshot with no stated update frequency; installation attributes describe services, not the structural condition of the buildings. Simulation uses: sports halls and grounds as evacuation shelters and assembly points, and accessibility analyses of public facilities. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: La Réunion: list of sports facilities (national sports facilities census)
